feature: Consent and Onboarding (Feature #1650, Git #3993): the 3 'portal'-origin GET /api/consent/callback redirect targets (consent-success acknowledgement, declined, tenant-conflict), the msp-onboarding invite-link landing page (GET /api/public/onboarding/link/:token), and the live REQUIRED_MT_SCOPES read the declined page uses (GET /api/public/consent-scopes -- already real and live off #433, public-consent-scopes.ts; not new in this build).
